inline:The target asserts an integration relation but frames it as the panel 'preventing the blind obedience failure mode of the deterministic process', yet declares the relation 'refuted if' the panel fails to statistically reduce the probability of algorithmic execution errors. The support content repeatedly frames the checklist itself as the variance-reduction mechanism that converts judgment into deterministic execution, while the non-expert panel merely supplies numbers. If the deterministic checklist is the source of reliability and the panel only executes it, then the panel cannot be the independent variable that reduces execution-error probability — the refutation condition compares a non-mechanism (the panel) against the mechanism (the deterministic process), so the stated dependence is self-defeating.
The support content (00321f6b7b18, 051b3183, 085fa305) states the checklist 'converts judgment to deterministic execution' and functions as the 'variance-reduction mechanism'; the target then makes the panel the preventive oversight and conditions refutation on the panel reducing execution-error probability. The very determinism the support attributes to the checklist means the panel is not the error-reducing factor, so the target's refutation condition is satisfied against itself.
